title: GNC - Trafik WAN
description: Trafik port WAN (deskripsi interface diawali 'Transit:') dari LibreNMS

list.name: host
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "gnc", tag: "hostname", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "ports", start: -30d)

list.name: port
list.label: Port
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "gnc", tag: "ifName", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "ports" and r.hostname == "${host}", start: -30d)

panels.title: Trafik semua port WAN (Transit)
panels.description: Port dengan deskripsi 'Transit: ...'. Kosong? Lihat panel petunjuk di bawah.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "gnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ports" and r.port_descr_type == "transit")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifInBits_rate")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with arah: "In"}))
  |> group(columns: ["hostname", "ifName", "arah"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "gnc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ports" and r.port_descr_type == "transit")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifOutBits_rate")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with arah: "Out"}))
  |> group(columns: ["hostname", "ifName", "arah"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

options.content:
Panel WAN membaca port yang **deskripsinya diawali `Transit:`**.

**Ruijie**
```
interface GigabitEthernet 0/1
 description Transit: Telkom-Astinet {100Mbps}
```
**MikroTik**
```
/interface ethernet set ether1 comment="Transit: Telkom-Astinet {100Mbps}"
```
Data muncul setelah polling berikutnya (±5 menit). Port mana pun tetap bisa dilihat lewat pilihan **Device** & **Port** di atas (panel bawah).
